candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing shorter unlock times than current time to be stored.
Replace addition to acc.balance with subtraction, so Put will decrease stored balance by msg.value instead of increasing it.
Replace require guard with a stricter check that also requires msg.value to be nonzero, preventing zero-value Put from updating state.
Insert an early return when msg.value is zero, so Put will not update state or emit a log on zero-value calls.
Replace the log call to change the recorded Data string from "Put" to "Deposit", altering externally visible logs recorded in LogFile.
Change the transfer call to use send instead of low-level call, which returns a bool and does not revert on failure; remove the revert so failures simply stop logging.
Swap the order of balance decrement and the external call so the external call happens before updating balance, allowing reentrancy to observe old balance.
Require strict time condition using >= instead of > so Collect can be executed at unlockTime exactly.
Remove the check that acc.balance>=MinSum so Collect can be called regardless of MinSum.
